mapper.select:
SELECT rp.user_id AS userId, wu.nickname AS nickname, rp.max_concurrent AS maxConcurrent, rp.weight_boost AS weightBoost, rp.is_all_community AS isAllCommunity, (rp.is_all_community = 1 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM runner_community rc WHERE rc.runner_user_id = rp.user_id AND rc.community_id = #{receiveCommunityId})) AS coverReceive,
(rp.is_all_community = 1 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM runner_community rc WHERE rc.runner_user_id = rp.user_id AND rc.community_id = #{storeCommunityId})) AS coverStore,
0 AS coverStore,
rp.reject_streak AS rejectStreak, rp.dispatch_miss_rounds AS dispatchMissRounds, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_main o WHERE o.runner_id = rp.user_id AND o.order_status IN (1, 2)) AS inTransit, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_main o WHERE o.runner_id = rp.user_id AND o.order_status = 3 AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND o.order_type = 1 AND o.finish_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)) AS doneCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_main o WHERE o.runner_id = rp.user_id AND o.order_status IN (3, 4) AND o.order_type = 1 AND o.update_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)) AS handledCnt, (SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, o.pay_time, o.finish_time)) FROM order_main o WHERE o.runner_id = rp.user_id AND o.order_status = 3 AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND o.order_type = 1) AS avgMinutes, (SELECT MAX(o.finish_time) FROM order_main o WHERE o.runner_id = rp.user_id AND o.order_status = 3) AS lastFinishTime FROM runner_profile rp JOIN wechat_user wu ON wu.id = rp.user_id WHERE rp.is_runner = 1 AND rp.online_status = 1 AND wu.is_enabled = 1 AND (rp.is_all_community = 1 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM runner_community rc WHERE rc.runner_user_id = rp.user_id AND rc.community_id = #{receiveCommunityId}))
